title: feat(mcp): a host that mounts a build door can tell a data-only MCP connection how to reach it (dataOnlyInstructions)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DQW1YS96PCik6rqZKv2GCtE)_

domain:server#6 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyG5vVX2AnojEzpmNa

Fixes #32766

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：MCP 授权注入新增可选字段 `dataOnlyInstructions`，用户用 API key、会话或只读/数据类 OAuth 连接时，`initialize` 回答宿主给的这段说明；SKILL.md 渲染器同名选项；默认说明句改为不承诺任何构建能力。
- 为什么改：执行 cloud#4329 裁决 B——保留 `metadata:write` 门，只在真正挂了构建入口的部署上提示"要构建请用带 metadata:write 的 OAuth 连接"；cloud 目前靠自己改写 `initialize` 应答（`withMcpBuildHint`），有了这个接口下次升版后即可删掉。
- 风险与回滚：宿主不传新字段时工具清单、SKILL.md 字节与授权路径完全不变；唯一可见变化是 HTTP 默认说明句换了措辞（旧句对只读 token 说"可修改数据"，不实）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` 的 `hostInstructions`（两段文案互补的选择逻辑）；`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` 的 `dataOnlyBlock` 条件；`packages/mcp/src/types.ts` 新字段注释。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-server-runtime.authoring-scope.test.ts src/skill-md.authoring.test.ts`，预期两个文件全绿，其中含 11 条 `[#32766]` 用例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

1. **A per-request seam for grants that do not admit the authoring family** (`packages/mcp/src/types.ts`, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`). `McpAuthoringInjection` gains an optional `dataOnlyInstructions: string`. `handleHttpRequest` reads it through `hostInstructions()`, which replaces `authoringInstructions()`: under the grant that admits the family (`grantsAuthoringTools`) it returns the injection's `instructions`, as before; under every other grant (a `data:read` / `data:write` / `actions:execute` token, an empty grant, the undefined grant of an API key or a session) it returns `dataOnlyInstructions`. One predicate, two complementary texts, so a request is answered with at most one of them. Either omitted or blank falls through to `config.instructions`, then to the default.
   - **Precedent named:** the shape is the one #31022 set for `McpAuthoringInjection.instructions` in this same file: per-request host text carried on the authoring injection and read under the grant predicate. It rides the injection rather than a new top-level `handleHttpRequest` option on purpose: only a host that injects an authoring registry, i.e. one that mounts a build door, can serve it. That is ruling B's constraint (the hint appears only where a build door is mounted) held by the type rather than by host discipline.
2. **The default sentence** (`DEFAULT_HTTP_INSTRUCTIONS`). It was "query and modify your app's data objects as tools", which overstated a `data:read` token (and a `metadata:write`-only or `actions:execute`-only one, which lists no data tool) and said nothing either way about building. It is now "ObjectStack MCP Server. The tools this connection lists depend on what its credential was granted." It promises no building, so it stays true on a deployment without a build door, and it is still the one default for every grant, so the authoring-grant answer without host text is the same text the data grants get, as the #31022 pin requires.
3. **SKILL.md** (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`). `RenderSkillOptions` gains the same-named `dataOnlyInstructions`, so a host passes one string to both surfaces. It renders verbatim, as its own block after the tool list, only when `authoringTools` names at least one tool (the host has a build door) AND `grantedScopes` do not admit the family: the exact complement of the authoring section. `GET /mcp/skill` stays public and unchanged: the framework route passes no authoring tools, so it renders byte-identical to before.
4. **Item 4 of the card is not in this PR.** The Connect page copy under `ui/packages/i18n` is `domain:ui`; it is handed to the seat as a carrier (see Acceptance notes).

The `registerSkillPrompts` region (#32767) is untouched.

## Tests

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.authoring-scope.test.ts`, new top-level `describe('[#32766] …')` (7 cases) in the existing harness:
- data grants (`data:read`, `data:read`+`data:write`, `actions:execute`, empty) with the seam are answered with the seam text, each with a control leg without it;
- the undefined grant (API key / session) is answered with the seam text;
- **negative:** a `metadata:write` request never sees the seam text: with `instructions` it gets them, unchanged from before; without them it gets the default, not the seam text;
- **negative:** a data-only request with no seam, or with no injection at all, gets a default that names no build, metadata, authoring or scope;
- **negative:** a blank text on either side is absent: the default answers, never an empty string;
- `tools/list` is identical with and without the seam, for a data grant and for `metadata:write`;
- the per-request seam beats `config.instructions`, and the configured text stays without it.

`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.authoring.test.ts`, new top-level `describe('[#32766] …')` (4 cases):
- a data grant and the undefined grant, with authoring tools handed in, render the block between the tool list and the conventions, keep the data description, and removing the block gives back the baseline byte-for-byte;
- **negative:** no build door (no authoring tools, or an empty list, under a data grant or `metadata:write`) renders the baseline byte-identically, text or not;
- **negative:** an admitting grant renders the authoring section and never the block (byte-identical to the same call without the text);
- a blank text renders nothing.

### Ablations (each negative pin, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; every mutation landed and every restore proved `git diff HEAD` empty)

| # | Head | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | `6a747c7a` | `hostInstructions` serves `dataOnlyInstructions ?? instructions` under the admitting grant | red: "a metadata:write request never sees the data-only text" (1 failed / 30 passed) |
| A2 | `6a747c7a` | the default sentence promises building over OAuth with `metadata:write` | red: "a data-only request … gets a default that promises no building" (1 failed / 30 passed) |
| A5 | `6a747c7a` | `hostInstructions` returns a blank text as-is | red: "a blank text on either side is absent" (1 failed / 30 passed) |
| A3 | `e2405ed4` | the SKILL.md block drops its "authoring tools handed in" condition | red: "no build door … renders the data skill byte-identically" (1 failed / 11 passed) |
| A4 | `e2405ed4` | the SKILL.md block drops its "grant does not admit the family" condition | red: "a grant that admits the family … never the data-only text" (1 failed / 11 passed) |

`skill-md.ts` is unchanged since `e2405ed4`. The mcp suites import `src/` relatively, so no dist rebuild sat between mutation and run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Public surface (Clause-② widening), measured on the built declaration closure:** after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp build`, `packages/mcp/dist/index.d.ts` carries `dataOnlyInstructions?: string` on `McpAuthoringInjection` and on `RenderSkillOptions` (both already exported from the package entry). No export added, removed or renamed; `DEFAULT_HTTP_INSTRUCTIONS` is module-private.
- **Host contract:** for the hint to show on an API-key or session request, the host passes `authoring` on that request too (the runtime already registers nothing for such a grant). A host that injects no registry cannot serve the text.
- **Cloud follow-up (carrier: objectstack-ai/cloud#4329):** after the next pin move, cloud can drop `withMcpBuildHint` (cloud `mcp-build-door.ts`) and pass its hint as `dataOnlyInstructions` on the injection it already builds, plus the same string to `renderSkillMarkdown` where it serves the skill. Not read from here: this session cannot reach `objectstack-ai/cloud` (403 on cloud#4329 comment 6826838112 and on cloud#4417), so the ruling is executed as the card quotes it.
- **Item 4, carrier for the ui lane (not filed here):** `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/developer/*.ts`, keys `connectAgent.apiKey.body` (en.ts:258) and the four client hints that send clients without browser sign-in to an API key: `connectAgent.codex.hint` (:225), `connectAgent.workbuddy.hint` (:229), `connectAgent.doubao.hint` (:234), `connectAgent.qwenwork.hint` (:239); all 11 locales (`en`, `ar`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `ja`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`). The ruling's constraint applies there too: a deployment without a build door must not be told about building.
- **Design review:** the seam shape and the ruling's red lines were re-read by an independent high-effort reviewer before the PR opened (verdict PASS). Adopted from it: blank host text counts as absent, the injection docs say a host passes it on API-key and session requests too (`principal` is not read there), and the default sentence was narrowed so it is true for a `metadata:write`-only or `actions:execute`-only token as well.
- **Serial with #32767** (same seat, `registerSkillPrompts` region): no PR open for it when this one opened; region-disjoint. This branch merged `origin/main` once (`c378c651`) before opening; per the seat's rule it merges again only if #32767 lands first.
